scope: Every serialized leaf in the frozen benchmark has exactly one field rule. Numerical choices are synthetic instantiations, not empirical claims.

fields.assumption: All evaluations refer to one declared formulation and fixed information state.
fields.benchmark_choice: Engineering provenance metadata, not a manuscript decision variable; IDs distinguish the three hand-authored update cases.

fields.assumption: Travel, carried unit mass, duration and energy have consistent dimensions.
fields.benchmark_choice: Unit convention: km; no commodity type axis.

fields.benchmark_choice: Unit convention: h; no commodity type axis.

fields.benchmark_choice: Unit convention: commodity_unit; no commodity type axis.

fields.assumption: The update epoch t lies in [0,T).
fields.benchmark_choice: t=1 h; executed actions have already been settled.

fields.assumption: All remaining operations must complete by fixed T, including equality.
fields.benchmark_choice: T=8 h for each paired projection.

fields.assumption: One divisible commodity with a positive unit mass m; payload mass equals m times scalar onboard quantity.
fields.benchmark_choice: m=2 kg per commodity unit; fractional deliveries are intentional.

fields.assumption: A bounded polygonal operating region contains all sites and is fully partitioned by wind cells.
fields.benchmark_choice: Rectangle [0,12] x [0,8] km; every cell remains traversable.

fields.assumption: The depot is fixed and active routes end there.
fields.benchmark_choice: One depot at (1,1) km.

fields.assumption: Tasks have fixed identifiers; remaining tasks have positive residual demand.
fields.benchmark_choice: Three tasks A, B and C.

fields.assumption: Visit paths join fixed task locations.
Demand is a nonnegative scalar and residual demand subtracts cumulative delivery.
fields.benchmark_choice: Demands 4, 1.5 and 2 commodity units.

fields.assumption: Fixed mandatory quantities lie between zero and demand; residual obligations subtract history.
fields.benchmark_choice: A and B require full demand; C requires 1.5 of 2 units.

fields.assumption: Positive deliveries must complete service before the fixed deadline.
fields.benchmark_choice: A deadline 3.9 h separates previous and revised feasibility; B/C deadlines are 6 h.

fields.assumption: Each UAV has its own observed position, load, battery and execution mode.
fields.benchmark_choice: Two UAVs U1/U2 with independent resource recursions.

fields.assumption: Fixed positive airspeed; wind changes ground speed.
fields.benchmark_choice: 10 km/h for both UAVs, above all wind magnitudes.

fields.assumption: Empty mass is positive and contributes to flight power.
fields.benchmark_choice: 2 kg for both UAVs.

fields.assumption: Linear flight-energy coefficient is positive with energy per mass per distance units.
fields.benchmark_choice: 0.5 Wh/(kg km), an illustrative surrogate, not a calibrated aircraft model.

fields.assumption: Departure preparation restores battery capacity; no replenishment away from depot.
fields.benchmark_choice: 100 Wh for both UAVs.

fields.assumption: Terminal and pre-recharge depot arrival batteries retain beta.
fields.benchmark_choice: 10 Wh reserve.

fields.assumption: Before/after-stop payload mass cannot exceed capacity.
fields.benchmark_choice: 6 kg (3 commodity units).

fields.assumption: Fixed finite positive route slot bounds are common to every scope.
fields.benchmark_choice: Five slots per UAV, including inactive canonical padding.

fields.assumption: Residual depot stock is a scalar fixed across projections; returned payload is not restocked.
fields.benchmark_choice: 6 units remain at the update epoch.

fields.assumption: Consistent history supplies cumulative deliveries between zero and initial demand.
fields.benchmark_choice: Settled history summary: A=1, B=0, C=0.5; pre-epoch trajectories are not replayed.

fields.assumption: The paired evaluations start at identical observed positions.
fields.benchmark_choice: U1 at depot, U2 at C.

fields.assumption: Observed batteries are fixed and bounded by capacity.
Onboard commodity is one nonnegative scalar, not a transfer decision.
fields.benchmark_choice: U1=0, U2=0.5 units.

fields.assumption: Observed execution mode determines any fixed unfinished operation.
fields.benchmark_choice: U1 idle; U2 is servicing C.

fields.assumption: Only an unfinished committed ground operation has residual data.
fields.benchmark_choice: Null for U1; U2 uses its fixed remaining service operation.

fields.assumption: An unfinished operation retains only its remaining duration.
fields.benchmark_choice: U2 has 0.05 h remaining; the generic protocol applies only after this leading service.

fields.assumption: Remaining service energy reduces observed battery once.
fields.benchmark_choice: U2 consumes the declared residual 0.2 Wh once.

fields.assumption: The remaining committed delivery is credited only at completion.
fields.benchmark_choice: U2 delivers its remaining 0.5 onboard units at the leading visit.

fields.assumption: Loading is restricted to depot preparation and only unfinished transfers are repeated.
fields.benchmark_choice: Zero for the residual relief service.

fields.assumption: Ground service duration is a prescribed deterministic function, with no independent waiting decision.
fields.benchmark_choice: Constant 0.05 h for fresh relief service.

fields.assumption: Prescribed service energy is subtracted away from depot.
fields.benchmark_choice: Constant 0.2 Wh for fresh relief service.

fields.assumption: Depot preparation loads and restores battery, with prescribed timing and no implicit queue.
fields.benchmark_choice: Constant 0.1 h for fresh preparation; residual preparation overrides it.

fields.assumption: Optional finite bay capacity applies to half-open simultaneous preparation intervals.
fields.benchmark_choice: Two bays; conflicts are infeasible, not automatically delayed.

fields.assumption: The finite spatial partition indexes wind values.
fields.benchmark_choice: L/R index two adjoining polygonal cells.

fields.assumption: Polygonal wind cells cover the operating region without overlapping interiors.
fields.benchmark_choice: Split at x=6 km; no cell excludes flight.

fields.assumption: Every shared boundary edge and vertex has exactly one owner.
fields.benchmark_choice: Lowest cell ID owns shared boundaries.

fields.assumption: Bins cover [t,T], are right-open except for the closed final endpoint.
fields.benchmark_choice: Knots 1,2,3,8 h for both tables.

fields.assumption: A common bound on wind magnitude is strictly below every airspeed.
fields.benchmark_choice: 9.5 km/h bound, so every direction is trackable.

fields.assumption: Previous received information is restricted to the common remaining domain.
fields.benchmark_choice: Previously issued at 0.5 h; evaluated at current state t=1, not replayed from 0.5.

fields.assumption: The newly received packet is issued at the update epoch.
fields.benchmark_choice: Issued at t=1 h; future packets are absent.

fields.assumption: Every cell-time wind vector is defined on the entire remaining horizon.
fields.benchmark_choice: Previous table is calm in both cells and all bins.

fields.assumption: Only wind vectors change between paired projections.
fields.benchmark_choice: Received vectors implement the benign, delay and late cases; fixed data are shared.

fields.assumption: A declared proper subset of cell-time entries contains every nonzero update.
fields.benchmark_choice: One L bin or two/three R bins change out of six entries. Support may conservatively include unchanged entries.

fields.assumption: Each visited remaining task has exactly one responsible UAV; repeated partial visits are allowed.
fields.benchmark_choice: A assigned to U1; B/C to U2; no cross-UAV split.

fields.assumption: Active slots form a depot-ending prefix; remaining slots use inactive padding.
fields.benchmark_choice: U1 revisits A after replenishment; U2 begins with pending C service.

fields.assumption: Directed piecewise-linear paths use normalized arclength; inactive paths are constant at depot.
fields.benchmark_choice: Caller-supplied paths include a zero-length leading service path and canonical padding.

fields.assumption: Delivery is scalar, occurs only at relief visits, and is zero at the virtual origin/inactive slots.
fields.benchmark_choice: Repeated fractional deliveries; total remaining service A=3, B=1.5, C=1.

fields.assumption: Loading is scalar and only at a depot before a subsequent leg; returned payload stays onboard.
fields.benchmark_choice: U1 loads 2 then 1, carrying 0.5 back; U2 loads 2.5.

fields.assumption: Committed coordinates retain incumbent values in every space, including Level 4.
fields.benchmark_choice: Component-specific mask: committed C assignment, selected first stops, U2 leading path and residual delivery; other coordinates remain mutable.

fields.assumption: Supplied return paths carry the current payload to depot without delivery/recharge; failure of one path does not disprove existence.
